angle: Instead of computing with the normal curve, this short piece teaches it as a visual vocabulary lesson, anchoring symmetry, center, and spread in plotted height data before naming the 68/95/99.7 bands and the standard normal.
angle_detail: Watch [01:44]–[02:43] first for the empirical bands, then [04:09]–[05:20] for the standard normal and the areas-as-probabilities framing. Heed its own caution that the second slot in N(mu, .) means variance here but standard deviation elsewhere, and expect definitions only: no standardization is worked and tables or software are only named. At five minutes it is a primer to pair with a source that actually solves problems.
